status_note: DYNHASH-UNIQUE-ANCHOR-0001 verification fixture (CASTFUSE-A correction root-cause triplet, piece 1): the pre-fix Rust calc_hash_vn dead-coded the base-phase buildVnDown pass (vnproc poisoned to mark_vn.len() between the two base loops), dropping every reader edge from the neighborhood CRC and mis-anchoring CAST-adjacent temps at the pre-skip defining COPY with the not-attached fallback bit; the locked oracle dynamic.cc:277-280 builds BOTH the up and the down edges from vnproc=0 in every calcHash(Varnode*, method) call. The fix (wt/dynhash a3017edc) restores the walk; this fixture is minted AFTER the fix, so all ten cases are byte-identical MATCH with a zero divergence budget, pinning the walk shapes that the copytrim_remat_1204 mint lines previously diverged on.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: calcHash/uniqueHash take the root Varnode by pointer and mutate only the DynamicHash member state (markvn/markop/vnedge/opedge, the vnproc/opproc/opedgeproc cursors, hash/addrresult); pieceTogetherHash clears the marks as its final mutation. uniqueHash(Varnode*) takes Funcdata* read-only for gatherFirstLevelVars. The Rust twin passes the Arc'd root and &Funcdata with the same mutation surface.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: dynamic.cc:277-278 walks the base up pass with a LOCAL index starting at vnproc WITHOUT consuming it; dynamic.cc:279-280 then walks the down pass from vnproc=0, so the root gets its up edge (def, crossing skip ops upward via getIn(0)) and down edges (every reader, crossing skip ops downward via loneDescend) in every method. Method 1/2/3 continue from the consumed cursor (inputs staged by buildOpUp / outputs by buildOpDown, then the corresponding edge builder over only the NEW varnodes). buildVnDown sorts the newly added edges by ToOpEdge::operator< (SeqNum address, then order, then slot) before they are folded.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: vnproc/opproc/opedgeproc reset to 0 at calcHash entry; the base two passes consume vnproc to markvn.size(); gatherUnmarkedOp advances opedgeproc over the edge list exactly once per staged batch; the champion loop in uniqueHash keeps the FIRST smallest collision list (strictly-smaller replacement, dynamic.cc:454-456) but tmphash/tmpaddr are overwritten every method iteration, so the emitted hash carries the LAST method's bits (the escaped loop variable, dynamic.cc:474) with the champion list's total/position — pinned by the champion_collision case.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: ToOpEdge::operator< compares op SeqNum address, then SeqNum order, then slot; ToOpEdge::hash folds slot, transtable[opcode], then getAddrSize() bytes of the op address LSB-first (crc_update consumes only the low 8 bits of each word, crc32.hh:37-39); pieceTogetherHash scans opedge in order for the first edge whose slot varnode IS the root (attached), falling back to opedge[0] with the not-attached bit; gatherFirstLevelVars filters ops at the address by translated opcode and slot and follows the not-attached bit through one skip op; findVarnode requires the recomputed collision total to match exactly before returning the varnode at the encoded position.

oracle.instrumentation_policy: No oracle source changes: the fixture only calls public APIs (Funcdata::newOp/newVarnodeOut/newVarnode/setInputVarnode/opSetInput/opSetOpcode/opInsertEnd/setHighLevel/clear, DynamicHash::calcHash/uniqueHash/findVarnode and the hash-decode statics). The private/protected access shim defines are inert for this surface and only mirror the copytrim_remat_1204 fixture shape.

analysis_options.entry: Direct construction per case: hand-built SSA bodies on fresh fd.clear() state (BfdArchitecture+real GetStr Funcdata on the Ghidra side; bare Funcdata twins on the Rust side). Pure DynamicHash observation surface: calc_hash_vn per method 0..3, unique_hash_vn with all decoded hash fields (method/opcode/slot/not-attached/position/total), and find_varnode round-trips by fixture varnode name. No symbols are minted (no ScopeLocal involvement); varnode explicit/implied flags are hand-set on the CAST-adjacent cases to mirror the ActionMarkExplicit/ActionMarkImplied production shapes.
analysis_options.funcproto_state: none (no prototype locking; register offsets chosen at 0x80+ outside the cspec [8,39) param window so no static symbol interferes)

rugra_source.archive_policy: Snapshot Cargo.toml + Cargo.lock + src/** + crates/** + benches/** from the pinned base commit (the fix commit); the fixtures and this metadata are overlaid from the working tree.

def_single_reader.covers: Base walk: up edge (def COPY, attached slot -1) + down edge (reader) folded into the CRC at method 0; methods 1/2/3 add the level-1 neighborhoods (inputs of marked ops, outputs of marked ops, inputs staged with down edges); uniqueHash resolves champion=1 at method 0 and findVarnode round-trips.

multi_reader_sort.covers: Three readers created out of address order: buildVnDown sorts the newly added down edges by ToOpEdge::operator< (SeqNum address, order, slot) before folding (dynamic.cc:147-148); anchor stays the attached def edge.

cast_above.covers: Root = CAST output (implied, explicit pre-skip side): the up walk crosses the skip CAST so the up edge is not attached to the root; the down edge at the reading op IS attached — the anchor is the reading op (0x3020) with slot 0, exactly the shape the pre-fix Rust walk mis-anchored at the defining COPY with the not-attached bit (copytrim_remat_1204 late_cast_retarget anchor divergence).

cast_below.covers: Root read via a CAST feeding a real op: the down walk crosses the skip CAST, folding the reading-op edge with the CAST output's slot; the attached def edge anchors the hash at the defining COPY.

double_cast_chain.covers: CAST(CAST(x)): t2 pins the multi-hop skip loop in buildVnUp with the attached reading-op anchor; t1 (mid-chain) has no attached edge on either side — the opedge[0] fallback fires with the not-attached bit (dynamic.cc:363-367) and findVarnode still round-trips via the gather redirection.

skip_no_reader.covers: CAST output with no reader: exactly one (not-attached) edge exists; the fallback bit is set and gatherFirstLevelVars follows it through the skip op (loneDescend of the COPY output hits the CAST, whose output is returned) so the lookup round-trips.

input_root.covers: Unwritten register input (newVarnode + setInputVarnode shape): buildVnUp contributes no edge; the anchor is the first sorted down edge, attached at slot 0 of the lower-address reader.

const_root.covers: Constant root: pieceTogetherHash folds the root size and offset bytes into the CRC (dynamic.cc:341-347); no up edge; reader-anchored at the first sorted down edge.

champion_collision.covers: Two identical-shape temps (defs share address 0x9000, readers share 0x9010): ToOpEdge::hash folds slot/opcode/address only, so t1/t2 hash identically at every method; uniqueHash keeps method-0's collision list as champion but emits the escaped method-3 tmphash bits (dynamic.cc:474) with total=2 and position 0/1; findVarnode recomputes with method 3, matches the total, and returns the varnode at the encoded position — the temps stay distinguishable through their hashes.

fold_detach.covers: Def+use anchored mint round-trips (pre ok=1); after the reader is rewired to the pre-copy varnode (RulePropagateCopy's IR effect) the recomputed neighborhood hash no longer matches — findVarnode returns null (postfold ok=0) and no op is created anywhere: the silent detach shape for vn-rooted dynamic entries.

overall_status: MATCH: DYNHASH-UNIQUE-ANCHOR-0001 fixed (wt/dynhash a3017edc) — all ten cases byte-identical, zero divergence budget; the remaining copytrim_remat_1201 pinned divergences belong to DYNMAP-SETPROPS-RET-0001 / DYNMAP-LATE-CAST-RETARGET-0001 / COREACT-DYNMAP-STUB-0001 / COREACT-DYNSYM-STUB-0001 (funcdata.rs / coreaction.rs domains, held by other lanes)
